description:
Charging points list

Returns a list of all publicly accessible charging points in the Netherlands.
Data comes from the NDW Open Data platform (DOT-NL); each charging point
includes all available source fields, including the complete `availabilities`
(counts, power, current type, tariff IDs and connector format per connector).
Optionally paginate with `page` (plus `per_page`, max 500; only then does the
response contain a `meta` block). Filter by city, status, availability or
connector type.

Cost: 0.5 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
